newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks open softer as golds drop.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks open softer as golds drop.

text.p: CHANGE CHANGE
NIKKEI 20402.74 -172.52 LME CASH NICKEL US$7255 -50
CANDLR 1.3840 LME CASH ALUM US$1689.5 +3.5
CAN 30-YR 120.34 -0.15 BRENT CRUDE US$18.59 +0.18
* Toronto stocks eased at Tuesday's open, pulled down by weaker golds while investors eye more U.S. economic statistics. * 6.7 million shares trade worth C$106.2 million.
Toronto's key stock index eased a bit in active trading at Tuesday's open, under pressure from weaker bond and gold bullion prices.
"Started off lower in reaction to some lower bond numbers," one trader said.
Bond investors sold some holdings to take profits after the U.S. employment cost index matched expectations for the second quarter, one analyst said.
The parade of today's U.S. economic data continued with the consumer confidence index, which slipped to 126.5 in July from 129.9 in June.
Gold bullion prices gave back Monday's gains, the trader added.
Toronto's heavily weighted gold group lost more than 0.5 percent in early trading.
Eight of 14 sub-indexes slipped, led by media, golds and consumer products. The firmer side included oils and base metals.
Losing issues outpaced advancers 227 to 191 while another 224 traded flat.
--- HOT STOCKS ---
* Prudential Steel Ltd jumped 5.75, or more than 12 percent, to 53 after second quarter earnings, reported on Tuesday, jumped to C$0.82 a share versus year-earlier C$0.23.
The pipe maker increased its quarterly dividend to C$0.15 from C$0.125 a share and posted a three for one stock split.
